Code 31/1/1. 32 page images (cover announces 31 printed pages; idx 31, folio 32, is blank). idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions; from idx 3 on the HINDI copy comes FIRST: every odd index 3-29 is the Hindi of the even page after it, and English sits on EVERY EVEN index 4-30 (idx 4 Q1, 6 Q2-5, 8 Q6-8, 10 Q9-12, 12 Q13-16, 14 Q17-20, 16 Q21-23, 18 Q24-26, 20 Q27-30, 22 Q31-33, 24 Q34, 26 Q35-37(c), 28 Q37(c) OR-Q38, 30 Q39). Odd-page tops checked: all Hindi, none carries English spill-over. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. General Instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 MCQ x1 (Q17-20 assertion-reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4 case/source-based; instruction (viii) prints NO count ('an internal choice has been provided in some Sections'), so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme for a bare OR: Q21, 23, 25, 29, 32, 33, 34, 37(c), 38(c), 39(c) = 10 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper (Q22, 24, 26, 27, 28, 30, 31, 35, 36 have none). Section E prints (a), (b), (c) OR (c). All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page images (ms idx 2-3); each re-derived and all 20 agree. Two unconditional awards outside Section A: Q27 part (a)(ii) and Q30 part (a), recorded in _cbseVoided. Decimal points on this paper are ordinary full stops (Q13 0.5; Q15 0.15 V). Opener of series 31/1: nothing skipped.
